tiling.projection: Ground X/Z; vertical-wall U is height and V is X or Z. 512 is an authoring choice, not a native universal tile scale.
tiling.preservation: Original triangle boundaries before int16 quantization; original corner colours; interpolated known colour bytes; unchanged unknown vertex fields. Collision is not an input to tiling.

allocation.preservation: All original bytes except object+0x14 and the displaced final word; no existing payload or unknown field moved or overwritten.

runtime_acceptance: Pending; this is an offline authored candidate, not a live appearance or general repacking result.
